data.title: Lick'em tongue brush cat-spa appointment
data.creativeFamily: serene pet ritual, absurd functional tool
data.audience: Pinterest users who save cat care ideas, unusual pet products, white elephant gifts, and deadpan visual humor
data.hook: A composed cat-spa portrait becomes strange only when the groomer is revealed to be using one rigid red mouth-held tongue brush.

references.lesson: Preserve one rigid red curved mouth tray, one connected broad tongue flap, short blunt underside pegs, ordinary roughly 4.5-inch scale, and mouth-held grooming use; never render a human tongue, loose hand brush, flexible strip, or mask.

notes: Three product-derived concepts with stop feature, click feature, product feature, fidelity risk, and swap test are recorded in the v8 README.
This ASIN and pet-grooming visual mechanism have not appeared in a public Goose Gifts Pin.
